integrity: Analytic proof supplied with exact symbolic checks; numerical or finite tests are not a substitute for proof. No independent validation or journal acceptance claimed.
scientific_limitations: Well-mixed continuous-time two-strategy games with fixed finite group size and strictly positive fitness entries; no assertion for asymmetric mutation, higher strategy counts, zero or negative payoffs, or mutation-free dynamics.
title: Sharp universal mutation threshold for convergence in positive-payoff multiplayer evolutionary games
